name: UCCS Pre-Collegiate Program
what_you_do: A free program that lasts several years and helps students plan for college and careers. It has a summer academic institute in June. Older students can earn 3 free college credits.
who_can_apply: Students entering grades 9 to 12 in El Paso or Pueblo counties. You must be first in your family to go to college, low income, or tied to the military.
duration: Multi-year program. Summer Academic Institute runs during June.
deadline_text: The Colorado Springs application link will be available at the end of January 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply online when the link opens at the end of January 2027.
notes: Students entering grades 11 and 12 can take a dual enrollment course for 3.0 college credits at no cost, Monday to Friday afternoons 1 to 3:30 PM during June. The program has run since 1987.
